cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(sakura_editor_app_lifecycle LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX "メモ: インクルード ファイル:  ")
set(CMAKE_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX "${CMAKE_CXX_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX}")

# Generated by tools/build/sakura_build.py. Do not edit.
get_filename_component(SAKURA_REPO_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../../../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../cmake-msvc-x64-release.cmake")
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_OBJECT_PATH_MAX 220)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_LIBRARIES "")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/pdb")

add_library(sakura_editor_app_lifecycle STATIC
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/_main/editor_lifecycle/EditorAppLifecycle.cpp"
  "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include/sakura/editor/lifecycle/EditorAppLifecycle.h"
)
target_include_directories(sakura_editor_app_lifecycle PUBLIC "${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/sakura_core/include")
target_compile_features(sakura_editor_app_lifecycle PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
set_property(TARGET sakura_editor_app_lifecycle PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded")
set_target_properties(sakura_editor_app_lifecycle PROPERTIES COMPILE_PDB_NAME "sakura_editor_app_lifecycle.compile" COMPILE_PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/pdb" PDB_NAME "sakura_editor_app_lifecycle" PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/pdb")
target_compile_options(sakura_editor_app_lifecycle PRIVATE /source-charset:utf-8 /execution-charset:utf-8 /Zp8 /Zc:wchar_t "/FI${SAKURA_REPO_ROOT}/src/main/modules/generated/abi/cmake-msvc-x64-release/sakura_editor_app_lifecycle.h")
target_compile_definitions(sakura_editor_app_lifecycle PRIVATE _ITERATOR_DEBUG_LEVEL=0 _WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00 NOMINMAX UNICODE _UNICODE)
